title: Tropical disk potential for almost toric manifolds
summary: Using our previous work we give a tropical formula for disk potentials for Lagrangian tori in almost toric four-manifolds, that is, fibrations by Lagrangian tori with only toric and focus-focus singularities, generalizing results of Mikhalkin for holomorphic spheres in the projective plane. As examples, we directly compute potentials for Lagrangian tori in del Pezzo surfaces equipped with monotone symplectic forms.
